title: Mr. Johnson's Greetings from Spain
passage:
To: 9thGradeClass@elite.edu
From: Johnson@elite.edu
Subject: Mr. Johnson's Greetings from Spain

Dear students,

It's Mr. Johnson here. I'm sending you this quick email from Barcelona, Spain. I hope you're all enjoying your vacation time.

Spain is fantastic. Right now, I'm sitting in a coffee shop. I can hear musicians playing their instruments on the sidewalk outside. One of my favorite places in Barcelona is a famous park where you can see lots of nice art. There are also some really interesting buildings in Barcelona, especially the ones designed by the famous architect Gaudí. One of his buildings, the Sagrada Familia, has taken 130 years to build, and it's still not finished.

I spend my days wandering around the city and my nights eating at amazing restaurants. Tonight, I'm going to surprise my wife by taking her to a secret restaurant. I'm not allowed to take photos inside. If I did, it would ruin the secret.

That's it for now. I'll see you all after winter break. Enjoy your time off.

All the best,
Mr. Johnson
